A '''formcot''' was a type of bed which molded itself to the user's body contours.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalist]] [[Den Dhur]] slept on a formcot in his quarters while reporting on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
